title: Frequent dream location
content: Anyone know this location? Cross posted. Does anyone have a dream location that continuously appears in dreams but you've never been there? I have some sort of gorgeous resort that will appear in dreams sometimes. Same one every time. Sometimes in my dreams I'm trying to locate this private resort. I've even seen it on incorrect maps in my dreams. It's a beautiful, all inclusive, multi cultural resort with different restaurants located in desert mountains. The water is crystal blue with coves and beach front. I feel like I need to find it in my reality but I don't think it exists. Does anyone know how to access this place intentionally?
